rows.detail: Acuitus records 56 Park Street sold for GBP236,000, sublet to New Look with an October 2026 option and a December 2025 head-rent review. New Look's current official locator confirms the Walsall store at Park Street with live opening hours. Current operation is strongly verified, but option exercise, turnover rent, review settlement, rent payment, legal completion, title and exact geometry remain unread.

Acuitus records the Banwell supermarket let to Southern Co-op until July 2030 with a July 2025 RPI review. Southern Co-op's current locator route and a September 2025 food-hygiene record bind the store to 44 Knightcott Road. Current operation is supported, but the review settlement, rent payment, first-floor flat occupation and any store-level effect of 2026 restructuring or administration risk remain fail-closed.

Acuitus records Tesco Express at 223 Station Road under lease to September 2031 with a September 2026 RPI review and historic residential consent over unused upper floors. Tesco's current official locator confirms the exact street address and active store but uses postcode UB7 7JF rather than auction postcode UB7 7NQ. The postcode variance, review outcome, upper-floor conversion implementation, rent payment, title and geometry remain unread.

Acuitus records the Gilwilly Industrial Estate trade counter sold prior, let to Travis Perkins until November 2031 and subject to a December 2026 upward-only review. A January 2025 acquisition report confirms Tandem bought the 27,500 sq ft scheme and that Travis Perkins had occupied it for twenty years. Current occupation and later ownership transition are strongly supported, but the December 2026 review, future GBP1 freehold option, rent payment, legal completion, title and exact geometry remain unread.

Current official pages confirm Primark at 121-135, H&M at 137-143, Schuh at 119 and H Samuel at 145-147. Footasylum's exact current occupation was not independently confirmed. Ground-rent payment, the review affecting 117, legal completion, title and exact geometry remain unread.

Rent payment, legal completion, title and geometry remain unread.

Residential upper-part occupation, ground rents, the November 2027 review, rent payment, title and exact geometry remain unread.

Acuitus records the Elder Road ground-rent interest sold for GBP270,000 and let to K J Shortis Ltd until April 2115, with a 2025 review.
